source_inspection.finding: Quarter-turn local-centre projection into integer Point refuses other angles; dependent validation/electrical registration requires this projected centre.
Existing source-relative exact45-degree querying is reusable historical behavior, not a replacement target.
Checked quadratic algebra uses sqrt2; it does not directly represent sqrt3 centres.
Certified arbitrary-angle bounds query shapes around integer centres; they cannot authorize rounded nonzero30-degree centres.
Footprint anchor consumers require integer PointNm centres. Unavailable Pad projection correctly refuses whole Footprint geometry rather than partial anchors.

thirty_degree_disposition.technical_limitation: For reflected local coordinates x,y and origin Tx,Ty, exact30-degree centre is (Tx+(sqrt3*x-y)/2, Ty+(x+sqrt3*y)/2). Integer/rational centre consumers cannot represent this generally; current sqrt2 machinery alone is insufficient.
thirty_degree_disposition.recommended_owner_choice: Ratify one bounded derived-geometry/quantity contract: query-only source-relative placed-Pad transforms and checked exact a+b*sqrt3 centre coefficients for the mandatory30-degree path; authorize necessary authoritative projection/contact, shared region-anchor, scene-binding and typed Inspector/context consumers using existing persisted pose, identities and revisions. Rendering approximations never establish membership, electrical or CAM authority.
exact_decisions_needed: Approve derived exact centre/geometry representation and its authoritative consumers; this is not a new canonical coordinate field.
Approve typed exact centre presentation/transport while preserving canonical source metadata and quantity policy; no rounded centre may feed predicates.

Approve bounded implementation with existing stored pose/IDs/profile only. Any demonstrated need for persisted schema/profile or additional algebraic authority returns to owner disposition before adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Mandatory30-degree eight-Pad Footprint:4-of8 refuses and5-of8 acquires on both board sides; complete per-Pad source identities and centre authority.
Complete Run/Net membership with exact source, geometry and electrical relationships; unchanged quarter-turn and existing45-degree behavior.
Revision qualification, cancellation and atomic whole-result publication preserved; no partial membership.
No source/journal mutation for read-only derivation; replay/reopen retain source bytes without drift.
Display/scene samples do not authorize geometry or manufacturing. Existing exact output/refusal and CAM/T04 boundary preserved.
thirty_degree_disposition.consequences: Enables mandatory missing behavior without general geometry rewrite, dependency, tolerance or scope reduction. Until explicit disposition, only dependent30-degree implementation remains blocked; other implementation and available proof do not gain acceptance.
